validation.browserEvidence: This batch passed 33 browser cases across all three engines: 12 native template layout, no-plot pane and formatter cases, 18 example-host template cases and three original autofit regressions. Actual built-site checks passed 30 states across desktop and 390-pixel layouts, including all four template controls. Data, source identity, copied values, pane weights, scale ownership, ranges, axis placement and rendered pixels were checked. Final engine, host and built-site screenshots were inspected. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
validation.website: 63 static pages built successfully; template example verified through initial state and all four controls at desktop and mobile widths in all three engines
validation.budgetChange: Template layout planning and validation add 2.31 kB to the workspace bundle (6.30 to 8.61). Scoped restore formatting and occupied-pane handling add 0.26 kB to base (108.87 to 109.13) and 0.38 KiB to chart-only imports (67.99 to 68.37). Limits are 109.5 kB base, 117.5 kB base plus trade, 247 kB terminal, 8.75 kB workspace, 289.5 kB all tiers and 68.5 KiB chart-only. All optional-tier removal checks pass.

Failing regressions reproduced hidden-scale recreation and selector-array accessor defects before the fixes. Both review findings are closed.
